image_slots.scene_description: রং-করা ও ট্রেসিং কার্যক্রমের একটি পৃষ্ঠা — উপরে একটি প্রাথমিক বিদ্যালয় ভবন (রং করার জন্য), নিচে ডট-আউটলাইনে একটি শাপলা (ট্রেস করার জন্য) ঢেউখেলানো মাটির রেখার উপরে; কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই, পতাকা নেই। পতাকা-রং বাদ (D-012); শাপলা-ট্রেসিং রক্ষিত।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only line-art colouring/tracing page; no living being, no flag/flagpole (flag-colouring omitted per D-012); শাপলা tracing retained as the pre-writing motor element; pass-through untouched in image chain (no stripe).
image_slots.prompt: A black-and-white line-art activity page for a young child (age 5-6) pre-writing and colouring book. Clean bold outlines only, no shading, no fill, no colour, on a white background; high contrast, thick clear lines that stay legible when photocopied. The page has two parts on one portrait sheet. Upper two-thirds: a simple friendly two-storey primary school building to colour in, with a pitched roof, rows of windows, a central door and a small entrance porch, a short garden path with a few potted flowering plants beside it; large open areas a small child can colour inside; no flag, no flagpole, no people, no animals, no birds, buildings and plants only. Lower third: a lotus flower drawn in a light dashed dotted outline for the child to trace over then colour, with layered petals and a couple of leaves on a short stem, sitting just above a gentle wavy ground line, clearly reading as a trace-the-dots outline. A few small solid-outline flowers or leaves along the bottom border as decoration. Simple warm children's-textbook style. No text, no letters, no writing anywhere on the page.

nctb_omitted.item: flag drawing (national flag colouring — flagpole + circle to colour)
